SELECT jmp.info, jmp.status, jmp.id AS participantId, jmp.created_time AS applyTime, jmp.merchant_id, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo
FROM joint_marketing_participant AS jmp JOIN merchants AS m ON jmp.merchant_id = m.id
WHERE m.is_enable = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND jmp.is_deleted = 0 AND jmp.plan_id = #{planId} AND jmp.role = 'PARTICIPANT' AND jmp.status = 'APPLY_JOIN'
ORDER BY jmp.created_time
